message.en: ⚠️ LAYER 1 RED LINE: Never leave the boardwalk in peat bog areas (Laguna Esmeralda, National Park). Peat bogs appear solid but can be several meters deep. Falling in can be fatal. Always follow marked wooden boardwalks, even if they seem to take a longer route.
message.zh: ⚠️ 第1层红线：在泥炭沼泽区域（翡翠湖、国家公园）绝不离开木栈道。泥炭沼泽看似坚实但可能深达数米。陷入可能致命。始终遵循标记的木栈道，即使它们看起来绕远了。

title.en: Review peat bog safety video before hiking
title.zh: 徒步前观看泥炭沼泽安全视频

title.en: Inform someone of your hiking route and expected return time
title.zh: 告知他人您的徒步路线和预计返回时间

title.en: Carry emergency whistle and first aid kit
title.zh: 携带应急哨子和急救包

askUser.en: Do you understand the peat bog hazard and will strictly follow boardwalks?
askUser.zh: 您了解泥炭沼泽危险并会严格遵循木栈道吗？

askUser.en: Have you hiked in similar terrain before?
askUser.zh: 您之前在类似地形中徒步过吗？

evidence.quote: Peat bogs are extremely dangerous. Never leave marked boardwalks. Falling in can result in death.

notes.en: This is a Layer 1 red line rule - violation can be fatal. TripNARA must enforce this strictly.
notes.zh: 这是第1层红线规则 - 违反可能致命。TripNARA必须严格执行。

message.en: ⚠️ LAYER 1 RED LINE: Ushuaia weather can change from clear to blizzard in hours. Never persist with outdoor activities in severe weather. Check weather forecast (SMN Argentina) before departure. If weather deteriorates, return immediately. Hypothermia risk is extreme.
message.zh: ⚠️ 第1层红线：乌斯怀亚天气可在数小时内从晴天变成暴风雪。在恶劣天气中绝不坚持户外活动。出发前查看天气预报（阿根廷气象局）。如果天气恶化，立即返回。失温风险极高。

title.en: Check SMN Argentina weather forecast before each outdoor activity
title.zh: 每次户外活动前查看阿根廷气象局天气预报

title.en: Pack emergency shelter, extra layers, and high-calorie food
title.zh: 打包应急庇护所、额外衣物和高热量食物

title.en: Learn hypothermia symptoms and treatment
title.zh: 学习失温症状和治疗方法

askUser.en: Do you have proper cold-weather gear for extreme conditions?
askUser.zh: 您有适合极端条件的适当冷天气装备吗？

evidence.quote: Ushuaia weather is extremely variable. Rapid changes from clear to severe conditions are common, especially in spring and autumn.

notes.en: This rule applies to all outdoor activities year-round. Weather is the primary hazard in Ushuaia.
notes.zh: 此规则适用于全年所有户外活动。天气是乌斯怀亚的主要危险。

message.en: ⚠️ LAYER 1 RED LINE: Never enter glacier areas without professional guide and equipment. Glacier crevasses are hidden and falling in is fatal. Mandatory equipment: crampons, ice axe, helmet, safety rope. Book only with licensed operators.
message.zh: ⚠️ 第1层红线：没有专业向导和装备，绝不进入冰川区域。冰川裂隙隐蔽，坠落可能致命。强制装备：冰爪、冰镐、头盔、安全绳。仅与持证运营商预订。

title.en: Book glacier activity with licensed operator (Canal Fun, Ushuaia Extremo)
title.zh: 与持证运营商预订冰川活动（Canal Fun、Ushuaia Extremo）

title.en: Confirm all safety equipment is included and properly fitted
title.zh: 确认所有安全装备已包含并正确安装

title.en: Review glacier safety briefing materials

askUser.en: Have you done glacier activities before?

askUser.en: Are you comfortable with heights and exposed terrain?
askUser.zh: 您对高度和暴露地形感到舒适吗？

evidence.quote: Glacier areas are extremely dangerous. Crevasses can be hidden under snow bridges. Professional guides and equipment are mandatory.

notes.en: This is a Layer 1 red line rule. Self-guided glacier activities are prohibited.
notes.zh: 这是第1层红线规则。禁止自助冰川活动。

message.en: ⚠️ LAYER 1 RED LINE: Beagle Channel water temperature is 4-10°C. Falling in causes hypothermia within 15-30 minutes. Mandatory: wear dry suit provided by operator, life jacket, and follow all safety instructions. Never underestimate water temperature.
message.zh: ⚠️ 第1层红线：比格尔海峡水温为4-10°C。落水会在15-30分钟内导致失温。强制：穿着运营商提供的干式服装、救生衣并遵循所有安全指示。永远不要低估水温。

title.en: Confirm dry suit and life jacket are provided by operator

evidence.quote: Beagle Channel water is extremely cold (4-10°C). Hypothermia can occur within minutes of immersion.

notes.en: This is a Layer 1 red line rule. Water temperature is the primary hazard for water activities.
notes.zh: 这是第1层红线规则。水温是水上活动的主要危险。

message.en: ⚠️ LAYER 1 RED LINE: Antarctica expedition REQUIRES travel insurance with medical evacuation coverage (minimum USD 100,000). No insurance = no boarding. Medical evacuation from Antarctica costs USD 100,000+. Most operators will refuse to board uninsured passengers.
message.zh: ⚠️ 第1层红线：南极探险需要包含医疗撤离保险（最低USD 100,000）。无保险=无法登船。从南极医疗撤离费用超过USD 100,000。大多数运营商会拒绝无保险乘客登船。

message.en: Ushuaia weather is unpredictable. Pack layered clothing: waterproof/windproof shell, warm mid-layer (fleece/wool), thermal base layer. Even in summer, bring warm layers. Wind chill can make it feel 10-15°C colder than actual temperature.
message.zh: 乌斯怀亚天气不可预测。准备分层衣物：防水/防风外层、保暖中层（抓绒/羊毛）、保暖内衣。即使在夏季，也要带保暖衣物。风寒可使体感温度比实际温度低10-15°C。

evidence.quote: Ushuaia experiences subantarctic climate with strong winds and rapid weather changes. Layered clothing is essential.

notes.en: This rule applies to all outdoor activities in Ushuaia, regardless of season.

notes.en: This rule applies specifically to winter travel (June-September).

summary.en: Ushuaia weather changes from clear to blizzard in hours. Strong Patagonian winds (30-50 km/h average, gusts 80-120 km/h) are common. Hypothermia risk is extreme.
summary.zh: 乌斯怀亚天气可在数小时内从晴天变成暴风雪。巴塔哥尼亚强风（平均30-50公里/小时，阵风80-120公里/小时）很常见。失温风险极高。

mitigations.en: Check weather forecast (SMN Argentina) before each outdoor activity
mitigations.zh: 每次户外活动前查看天气预报（阿根廷气象局）

mitigations.en: Pack layered clothing: waterproof/windproof shell, warm mid-layer, thermal base layer
mitigations.zh: 准备分层衣物：防水/防风外层、保暖中层、保暖内衣

mitigations.en: Be prepared to turn back immediately if weather deteriorates
mitigations.zh: 如果天气恶化，准备立即返回

summary.zh: 泥炭沼泽看似坚实但可能深达数米。陷入可能致命。位于翡翠湖和国家公园区域。

mitigations.en: NEVER leave marked wooden boardwalks in peat bog areas

mitigations.en: Have backup accommodation if your flight is delayed
mitigations.zh: 如果航班延误，有备选住宿

quick_checklist_summer.bestFor: Summer travel with relatively mild weather
quick_checklist_summer.bestFor_zh: 夏季旅行，天气相对温和
items: Socks x5-7 (bring extra, get wet easily)
whatToSkip: Heavy down jacket (unless going to Highlands)
criticalReminders: Even in summer, prepare for cold and rain
Wind chill makes it feel 10-15°C colder
Bring more socks than you think you need

quick_checklist_transition.bestFor_zh: 天气不可预测，条件多变
items: Light down jacket or heavy fleece x1

quick_checklist_winter.bestFor: Cold, snowy conditions with short daylight
quick_checklist_winter.bestFor_zh: 寒冷、多雪的条件，白天短
items: Heavy down jacket or parka x1
Headlamp with extra batteries x2-3 (only 7-9 hours daylight)
criticalReminders: Must prepare for extreme cold (-5 to -15°C)
Bring more socks and gloves than you think

packing_order_steps.name: Gather all items
packing_order_steps.items: Lay out all items on bed or floor

packing_order_steps.name: Organize by category
packing_order_steps.why: Easy to find critical items quickly

packing_order_steps.name: Pack critical items (carry-on)
packing_order_steps.container: Small waterproof bag, front pocket of backpack

packing_order_steps.name: Pack clothing by layer
packing_order_steps.why: Easy to find and organize for layering

oneDayBefore: ☐ Passport check: Valid? Visa attached? Copies made?
☐ Flight tickets: Printed or screenshot? Offline saved?
☐ Car rental confirmation: Pickup time and location clear?
☐ Accommodation confirmation: First night address and contact saved?
☐ Weather forecast: Check SMN Argentina for next week
☐ Road conditions: Check for any closures or warnings
☐ Travel insurance: Verify coverage, especially for activities
threeHoursBefore: ☐ All devices charged: Phone, power bank, camera batteries
☐ Clothing final check: All packed? Tried on?
☐ Documents final check: Passport, driver's license, credit cards?
☐ Critical items in carry-on: Passport, wallet, phone, power bank

winter_specific: Crampons or ice cleats (MANDATORY for winter)

packing_tips: Use compression bags to save space
Bring more socks than you think (get wet easily)
Use plastic bags for wet clothing
Pack items in order of use (last used on top)
Label all bags for easy identification
what_not_to_bring: Don't bring too much cash (most places accept credit cards)
Don't bring clothing that doesn't layer well
Don't bring devices without spare batteries
Don't bring heavy items you won't use
Don't bring more than 2 pairs of shoes
ushuaia_specific_tips: Bring more warm layers than you think you need
Wind chill is extreme - waterproof shell is critical
Socks get wet easily - bring 8-10 pairs
Headlamp is essential, especially in winter
Emergency shelter can save your life
Bring high-calorie snacks for remote areas
Sunscreen is important even in winter (UV reflection from snow)
